title: Normalized event
description: The item shape produced by the 'Edit Fields' node and extended by the 'Code in JavaScript' node in the AI SOC Assistant. Status: implemented — this is the real internal data contract of the shipped workflow.

message.description: The raw text the analyst pasted. Sent to the model verbatim as the user message. Attacker-influenceable; see docs/threat-model.md.

channel.description: Slack channel ID the event arrived in. Used to route the reply.

user.description: Slack user ID of the sender. Compared against SLACK_BOT_USER_ID by the loop guard.

thread_ts.description: Thread timestamp. Computed as event.thread_ts || event.ts so the reply lands in the originating thread.

=event_type.description: Slack event type. The key name genuinely begins with '=' in the shipped workflow — a stray expression prefix typed into the field-name box. Preserved because this schema documents what runs. Nothing reads it.

input_type.description: Classification result added by the Code node. Determines Switch routing.

system_prompt.description: Source-specific analyst prompt, added by whichever Edit Fields2-8 node the Switch selected. Absent for input_type values whose Switch output is not connected (ip, hash, linux).
